title: Add OverviewStore to ServerStores and new_mem()
description:
What: OverviewStore is implemented in store/overview.rs but is absent from ServerStores. Add it.
Algorithm:
1. In crates/reader/src/store/server_stores.rs:
   a. Add import: use crate::store::overview::OverviewStore;
   b. Add field to ServerStores: pub overview_store: Arc<OverviewStore>
   c. In new_mem(): create OverviewStore using the reader pool (already has overview migrations):
      overview_store: Arc::new(OverviewStore::new(reader_pool.clone())),
      Note: reader_pool is used for both article_numbers and overview (both have reader migrations)
2. Verify cargo build -p usenet-ipfs-reader compiles
Defensive: overview_store is read from the same pool as article_numbers (reader migrations).
Acceptance: cargo build clean.
